notes: ADR-0182 recorder: Cboe 15-minute-delayed full option chain JSON per underlying (no credential). Register as source 'cboe-chain' with connector dskit.onboarding.libs.cboe:CboeConnector; acquire stream option_chain with --mode live twice per trading day (15:50 and 16:20 ET) into a durable root (~/data/index_options/ob). roots is an allowlist (SPXW PM weeklies/dailies and XSP); max_dte bounds the expiries kept. Recorded chains later calibrate the VIX proxy's skew/spread knobs and, once expiries settle, replace it.
